datastore.description: The settings to connect to the data source

store_type.description: The type of data store provider

host.description: The fully qualified hostname of the provider

port.description: The port to use to connect with the provider

user.description: The user ID of a user with the following permissions: Create Temporary Table; Select, Insert, Delete, and Update  on Table *; Execute Function *; Execute Procedure *

password.description: The password for the user, encrypted using the II CLI

oauth.description: The settings for OAuth 2.0 and OIDC integration

auth_code_pkce.description: The credentials to use for the OAuth Authorization Code Flow with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE)

client_credential.description: The credentials to use for the OAuth Client Credentials Flow

client_id.description: The Client ID issued by the OAuth provider

client_secret.description: The Client Secret issued by the Oauth provider, encrypted using the II CLI
